BMW M350 xDrive Gets Virtually Redesigned With Angel Eyes, the Digital BMW M3 Also Enters the Chat
9 photos
Photo: Timur Altynbayev / Behance
BMW is in the middle of its largest product offensive in modern times, which kicked off last fall with the launch of the second-gen NA5 BMW iX3 Neue Klasse compact electric crossover SUV. And they are now building an avalanche.
The tidal wave continued this spring with the NA0 battery electric compact executive car – the second-generation BMW i3 – now a sedan of the Neue Klasse clan. These two have all the Neue Klasse assets – outside, inside, and the dedicated EV platform. There’s also the brand-new NA7 first-ever BMW iX4 coupe-SUV, along with a bunch of partial Neue Klasse models that were kept on the enhanced CLAR platform for various reasons.
Those include the mid-cycle refresh of the BMW 7 Series and i7, the all-new BMW X5 (G65), which remained on CLAR to support no less than five different powertrains, or the G50 BMW 3 Series, the eighth generation of the compact executive model. Additional Neue Klasse novelties are coming, like the recently leaked BMW i3 Touring, the spied BMW 5 Series facelift, or the fresh BMW M5 and M3 – the latter set to be offered both with ICE and EV options.
Speaking of the BMW 3 Series and the M3, everyone had something to say about the fresh top-of-the-line M350 xDrive and its exclusive yellow daytime running lights plus the enhanced 3.0-liter B58 turbo inline-six engine that now churns out no less than 437 hp. Naturally, the rumor mill also chipped in, along with the members of the imaginative guild of digital car content creators dwelling across the parallel universes of vehicular CGI – even if some of them did it later than others.
For example, the virtual artist Timur Altynbayev is from Kazakhstan, but his latest unofficial, hypothetical design projects feel targeted at the Bavarian areas of Munich because he’s ready to show us their unofficial, hypothetical design project based on the BMW 3 Series G50, the M350 xDrive in particular.
The pixel master says that he feels like the new BMW 3 Series can easily be reskinned with references to the legendary E30 BMW M3 coupe. So, at the front of the M350 xDrive, he added the Neue Klasse illuminated kidneys from the latest X5 along with dual round LED surround daytime running lights, bringing back the iconic ‘angel eyes’ in a modern manner.
Around the back, he lowered the edge of the trunk line and also made the rear LED clusters “bigger and shorter” to pay a distinctive tribute to the E30 BMW M3. While we’re still on the subject of the M3, by the way, the artist didn’t stop with the M350 xDrive and also imagined a potential Neue Klasse BMW M3 based on the project, with all the front LEDs dressed in yellow and a monster aerodynamic package plus dual central exhausts!
